# Architecture Specification: Complaint Management System
**Generated by:** Stage 1: System Architect  
**Task Scope:** Full-stack Architecture, RLS Enforcement, Anonymous Whistleblower Model, Multi-Portal Role Guards

---

## 1. System Topology & Architectural Invariants
```
[User / Staff / Admin Clients] 
          │ (HTTPS)
          ▼
[Next.js App Router (Cloudflare Edge / Node)]
          │ 
          ├──> [Middleware: Session & Role Guard]
          │
          ├──> [Supabase Auth (OAuth / Password)]
          │
          └──> [Supabase PostgreSQL + Storage]
                     ▲
                     │ (Row-Level Security Enforcement)
                     ├── Profiles (user, staff, admin)
                     ├── Categories
                     ├── Tickets (is_anonymous, tracking_code)
                     ├── Ticket Messages (is_internal)
                     └── Attachments
```

---

## 2. Core Security & Domain Invariants
1. **Zero-Trust Anonymous Whistleblower Model:**
   - When `tickets.is_anonymous = true`:
     - Staff can query ticket metadata, description, and status.
     - Database RLS prevents Staff role from reading `profiles` data belonging to the complainant.
     - Admin holds unmasked audit rights for safety compliance.
2. **Dual-Channel Message Isolation:**
   - `ticket_messages.is_internal = false`: Public visibility (User + Assigned Staff + Admin).
   - `ticket_messages.is_internal = true`: Internal team visibility (Staff + Admin only). RLS blocks any query matching User UID.
3. **Tracking Code Decoupling:**
   - Every ticket generates a non-sequential `tracking_code` (e.g. `TRK-XXXX-YYYY`) allowing status lookup without requiring active authenticated sessions.
4. **Finite State Machine:**
   - `SUBMITTED` -> `RECEIVED` -> `IN_PROGRESS` <-> `WAITING` -> `RESOLVED` -> `CLOSED`
   - Only User UID owning the ticket can trigger `RESOLVED` -> `IN_PROGRESS` (Re-open).

---

## 3. Data Contracts & Table Specifications
- **`public.profiles`**: `id (UUID, PK)`, `email (TEXT)`, `full_name (TEXT)`, `role (user_role ENUM: 'user'|'staff'|'admin')`
- **`public.categories`**: `id (UUID, PK)`, `name (TEXT)`, `description (TEXT)`
- **`public.tickets`**: `id (UUID, PK)`, `ticket_code (TEXT, UNIQUE)`, `tracking_code (TEXT, UNIQUE)`, `user_id (UUID, FK)`, `assigned_staff_id (UUID, FK)`, `category_id (UUID, FK)`, `title (TEXT)`, `description (TEXT)`, `is_anonymous (BOOLEAN)`, `status (ticket_status ENUM)`
- **`public.ticket_messages`**: `id (UUID, PK)`, `ticket_id (UUID, FK)`, `sender_id (UUID, FK)`, `message (TEXT)`, `is_internal (BOOLEAN)`
- **`public.ticket_attachments`**: `id (UUID, PK)`, `ticket_id (UUID, FK)`, `file_name (TEXT)`, `file_url (TEXT)`
